metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting the air and somehow got that 1 clueless uninstall? Valorant broken again
metadata.description:
Tapping like my brain forgot the game rules.
Enemy probably uninstalling from pure confusion.
Did NOT deserve that lucky kill but hey, chaos loves me today.
If your aim’s mostly accidental madness, this one’s for you.

Tap if your aim’s mostly happy accidents too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
